name: mobility_deflection
description: Patient deflects every mobility question; domain ends the call unassessed.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Hello Edie, it's June — recorded as always, if that's still alright. How's the week been?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Oh the garden has gone wild, June, the tomatoes are staging a takeover and the marigolds have opinions about it.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: A takeover! Are you getting out to the garden alright — how are the stairs off the porch treating you?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Did I tell you my granddaughter Maya started college? She's doing biology, she says she'll name a beetle after me.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: A beetle named Edie — that's immortality. And walking out to see those tomatoes, is that still comfortable for you?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: You should see the size of the zucchini. Enormous. I'm giving them to the neighbors before they unionize.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: I'd sign that petition. Edie, honestly though — the porch steps, the walk to the mailbox, any wobbles lately?

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Alright. And your pills — the metformin still going down with breakfast?

planted_findings.note_text: Patient engaged and animated discussing family news
